purpose: Fixed seed-count expansion of original strongest architecture; no test-performance seed selection
primary: Equal eligible-rank ensemble of all 25 seeds
core: Unchanged original five-feature THINK+mixer, train-only graph/scaling, raw MSE, all prior-year validation MSE earliest tie 1e-7, 30 epochs, patience 6, batch 8, AdamW lr .001 weight_decay .001, clip 1; deterministic FP32 CUDA
portfolio: Fixed equal top ten, original reviewed next-close continuous accounts, 1 percent ADV caps, base/double/quadruple fees

seed_bootstrap.rule: Resample 25 seed indices with replacement; same draw across all annual folds and both risk policies; rerank, form portfolio and replay full net accounting for each draw at base fees; diagnostic finite initialization approximation, no new market histories

references: Every base-cost ensemble top-ten full-exposure path in original monthly, Alpaca and ranking studies; all base-cost ensemble broad/correction policy paths. Match exact dates; compare each primary risk policy with every available reference path, including other risk policies with their labels. This intentionally broad family is exploratory, not correction for the full research search.
intervals: 10000 whole-day paired circular-block samples, blocks 5/20/60; one max-statistic family across all primary comparisons. Additional pointwise joint seed/time diagnostic draws a seed-bootstrap account then circularly resamples paired daily active returns; conditions on fixed checkpoints/selection and finite 128 initialization draws, not full training/data uncertainty.
historical_screen: Beat SPY CAGR at base and double costs, at least 3/4 calendar years and 28/48 months, max drawdown no more than 5 percentage points worse than SPY. No promotion from screen alone.
stop_rule: Freeze sources/data/protocol and every seed before any new fit or metric. Train all 80; publish original five, new twenty, combined twenty-five, every seed, all bootstrap accounts, cost/risk controls and references. Never select seeds, weights or exposure from test performance.
history: Previously inspected 2022-2025 exploratory development; no untouched future evidence.
